notes.title: DEMO 0.3.2
notes.content:
Dash or Die DEMO get another minor but critical update !

- Camera is now even better and smoother
- Added 1 hidden hat
- Changed a jump velocity that was not powerfull enough in the lighthouse section
- Solved a bug where gliding was conflicting with running, resulting in a glide malfunction
- Solved a bug where running and stop running changed velocity randomly

Keep gettin updates before launch and wishlist now !

notes.title: DEMO 0.2
